facts.content: Patient reports dry, itchy skin for a few days.

facts.content: Patient has pruritus and redness mainly on arms and hands that began a few days ago after swimming.

facts.content: Patient reports mild fatigue.

facts.content: Assessment of mild fatigue in an otherwise well patient.
Recommend regular emollients applied liberally throughout the day to affected areas.
facts.source_text: Recommend regular emollients to affected areas (liberal use throughout day)

facts.content: Recommend topical corticosteroid cream for inflamed areas, to be offered or prescribed per clinician discretion.

facts.content: Recommend over-the-counter oral antihistamine such as piriton or loratadine as needed for itch.

facts.content: Advise patient not to rely on coconut butter if it is ineffective and to avoid potential triggers such as recent pool exposure and harsh soaps.

facts.content: Paracetamol or other painkillers are not indicated.

facts.content: Patient is advised to return for review in about one week if there is no improvement or sooner if symptoms worsen or systemic symptoms develop.
